summary: zip parameters: original list, additional lists, and strict (default false) to error on length mismatch instead of truncating to the shortest.
questions: What happens when zipping lists of different lengths?
How do I make zip fail if the lists aren't the same length?

answer_card.title: zip parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (list, required): original list
- `_additional_lists` (required): additional list(s)
- `strict` (default false): if true, error on mismatched lengths; otherwise the shortest list determines the output
